origin.basis: TUFO, s.r.o. is based in Otrokovice, the Czech Republic (contact page).

manufacturing.basis: Tufo does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Priced in euros on Tufo's own site; other regions not verified.

name: Comtura Prima TT
positioning: Tufo's fastest road tire, a lighter tubeless-ready Comtura Prima.
hookless_note: Tufo lists it as hookless compatible and links a rim-compatibility chart.
caveats: Despite the 'TT' name, Tufo lists it for road cycling without time-trial wording.
Only 28 mm is listed; pressure limit not stated.

price_observations.conditions: Official price per tire on 2026-11-01 (incl. VAT); shipping extra.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: Feels pleasant and fast and suits time trials, but in general road use it wore incredibly fast and grew more fragile as it wore.
